name: 旅行攻略
description: 从目的地和天数做出一份能照着走的旅行攻略：备选地点（标出要预约、要核实的信息）→ 按天排的行程（交通衔接、留白、雨天备选）→ 小红书式攻略笔记 → 检查每天的节奏、时间衔接、预算和出发前要核实的清单。 / Turn a destination and a number of days into a guide you can actually follow: candidate places (flagging bookings and facts to verify) → a day-by-day itinerary (transfers, free time, rainy-day backups) → a shareable guide note → checks on daily pace, timing, budget and the pre-trip verification list.

destination.description: 目的地，例如：泉州 / Where to, e.g. Quanzhou

month.description: 几月去，例如：10 月 / When, e.g. October

travelers.description: 谁去，例如：带 6 岁孩子的一家三口 / Who is going, e.g. a family with a 6-year-old

budget.description: 每人预算（不含往返大交通）/ Budget per person, excluding getting there and back

pace.description: 节奏：relaxed 悠闲（每天 2 个主要景点），normal 正常（3 个），packed 紧凑（4 个）/ Pace: relaxed (2 main sights a day), normal (3), packed (4)

language.description: 输出语言：zh 中文，en English / Output language: zh or en

stages.name: 备选地点
stages.description: 景点、吃饭和住宿的备选，每个写区域、建议游玩时长、大概花费、要不要预约，以及出发前必须自己核实的信息。 / Candidate sights, food and stays, each with its area, suggested time, rough cost, whether booking is needed, and what you must verify yourself before going.

stages.name: 按天行程
stages.description: 按区域排每天的行程：每站的时间、时长和到下一站的交通，每天留出空闲时间和一个雨天备选，再列出每人的预算。 / Each day grouped by area: times, durations and the transfer to the next stop, free time every day and a rainy-day backup, plus the budget per person.

stages.name: 攻略笔记
stages.description: 写成可以直接发的攻略：标题、行程概览、每天怎么走、交通、预算表、避坑和出发前核实清单。 / A guide ready to post: title, overview, each day, transport, budget table, pitfalls and the pre-trip checklist.

stages.name: 检查
stages.description: 检查每天主要景点是不是超过节奏、有没有留白和雨天备选、时间加交通接不接得上、行程里的地点是不是都在备选里、预算有没有超，以及要预约的地方有没有进核实清单。 / Checks main sights per day against the pace, free time and rainy-day backups, whether times plus transfers fit, that every stop is a known place, the budget, and that places needing a booking are on the checklist.
